title: Intrinsic and varying-ring semilinear proper/open mates agree
statement: For every inverse sequence of commutative rings in the recorded universes and every commutative square k:V→W, r:V→S, p:W→T, i:S→T with k,i quasi-compact open immersions and r,p proper, the intrinsic proper/open mate [def-coef-semilinear-proper-open-mate] is heterogeneously equal to the varying-ring proper/open mate [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows]. The heterogeneous equality uses the actual equalities of their chosen inverse image, direct image and open extension functors; it is an equality on entire unbounded derived system categories, with no faithfulness of evaluation or coefficient-flatness hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 07A7: intrinsic proper/open clopen construction and specified adjunction mate; exact-localization calculation on simultaneous coefficient systems.

proof.text: The coefficient maps agree on every section, so the ordinary push functors agree. The chosen ordinary adjunctions, inverse images and open extensions then agree; their section-normalized direct-image compositors agree.
Exact localization preserves the inverse mate defining beta by [lem-sf-exact-localization-inverse-mate]. The derived pullback square is the localization of its ordinary word.

The localized ordinary projector and the intrinsic projector both restrict to the open-adjunction unit on the selected clopen image. Since the canonical extension-to-direct-image comparison is invertible, the proper-adjunction Hom bijection makes this restriction determine the projector, by the uniqueness calculation of [lem-cbc-proper-open-clopen-projector].

Normalize open composition using [lem-sf-exact-localization-open-compositor]. Exact-derived transformation pasting [lem-sp-exact-derived-transformation-pasting] then identifies the whole beta-projector-compositor alpha word.
Take proper-adjunction mates under the identified chosen adjunctions. Heterogeneous equality transports this construction and gives the stated equality.
